items.title: Man admits sexually assaulting woman drugged by husband
items.summary: The husband is accused of inviting 13 other men to abuse her at their family home in Greater Manchester.

items.title: How did Christa Pike survive execution attempt - and what happens next?

items.title: Royal Mail plans to cut 2,500 jobs

items.summary: The step comes after several groups complained of police using disproportionate force towards teenagers.

items.title: Husband appears in court accused of GP's murder

items.title: Chemistry Nobel awarded for solving mystery of life's asymmetry
items.summary: The prize was given to the French and Japanese scientists for solving the mystery of life's asymmetry.

items.title: Widdecombe suspect in court charged with preparing terrorist acts against Farage
items.summary: Joshua Kerry, 28, appeared at Westminster Magistrates Court and was remanded in custody.

items.title: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab worker's death in Russia
